definitions.explanation: A journey made by ship or boat, whether for leisure (a cruise), transportation (a ferry crossing), or adventure.

examples.japanese: {船旅|ふなたび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{瀬戸内海|せとないかい}→瀬戸内海：30793_setonaikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{船旅|ふなたび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}った→巡る：03930_meguru⟧。
examples.english: I toured the Seto Inland Sea by boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{船旅|ふなたび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It takes longer than flying, but boat travel has a relaxing charm.

notes:
Composed of {船|ふな} (boat, ship) + ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (travel, journey). The reading {船|ふな} uses the native Japanese (kun'yomi) reading, as is common in compound nouns with ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船旅|ふなたび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy a boat trip
- {船旅|ふなたび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to set out on a voyage
- ⟦{世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}→世界一周：29922_sekaiisshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{船旅|ふなたび}: around-the-world cruise
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な{船旅|ふなたび}: luxury cruise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クルーズ: cruise (loanword; typically implies luxury)
- ⟦{航海|こうかい}→航海：02797_koukai⟧: voyage, navigation (more formal/technical; emphasizes the sailing itself)
- ⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧: overseas travel (by any means, not just ship)
